title: Front-program computation bound
statement: For natural numbers $C,d,n$, on input consisting of $n$ ones and starting at the initial reading label with all five registers zero, there exist final register values and a final input position such that the program halts and appends the word consisting of $n$ ones, then a zero, then $(C+1)(n+1)^d$ ones, then a zero. This run relation holds uniformly for every output string already printed, with a step bound of $\bigl(30+C+5d+14d(C+1)\bigr)(n+1)^{d+1}$.
hypotheses_covered: input is the string of $n$ ones
initial register values are all zero
